question:
I am using Jinja2 inside DBT. Jinja2 loop controls (break, continue) are not working. it is throwing below error:

Encountered unknown tag 'break'. Jinja was looking for the following tags: 'endfor' or 'else'. The innermost block that needs to be closed is 'for'.

I tried multiple ways but not able to import jinja2.ext.loopcontrols in DBT.
title: How to import jinja2.ext.loopcontrols in DBT
answer:
You can't import loopcontrols EDIT- I guess you CAN import it, but I wouldn't recommend altering the DBT code to do so.

You can just simply use return() if you want to break and don't have any logic after your loop.

If you don't want to use return(), you can do something like this

{% macro test() %}
  {% set break_tracker = namespace(is_finished = False) %}
  {% for i in range(5) if not break_tracker.is_finished %}
    {% if i == 3 %}
      {% set break_tracker.is_finished = True %}
    {% else %}
      // Do something
    {% endif %}
  {% endfor %}
{% endmacro %}
